sources.snippet: Overview bert-base-turkish-cased is a BERT model trained specifically on Turkish text, developed by dbmdz, the MDZ Digital Library team at the Bavarian State Library. The model is a cased variant, meaning it distinguishes between uppercase and lowercase letters, which is particularly important for Turkish text processing.
